observations.atomic_claim: Preserve observable behavior for exports:.
create_plan("", content, "SELECT  a     b") returns a plan whose query is "SELECT a b" and whose content carries the computed maximum metrics.
cleanup_source strips psql frames and headers, and split_into_lines rejoins force-wrapped continuation lines, matching the TypeScript contracts.
from_text recognizes never-executed markers, InitPlan/SubPlan/CTE/Worker blocks, JIT/Planning/Serialization sections, Buffers, I/O Timings, Sort/Group/Hash keys, Memory and Cache lines.

observations.surface: CTE Scan and InitPlan duration corrections
observations.atomic_claim: create_plan subtracts matching CTE total time from CTE Scan exclusive durations and removes InitPlan usage time from consuming nodes, skipping both when isAnalyze is false.
get_plan_content on an array whose first element has a Plan member returns that first element as the plan content.
All new files live under /workspace/repo and the base commit 6d14a4f65b7400b9a877d6ec583f07f364f2267d history is preserved rather than replaced.
split_into_lines leaves no item with unbalanced parentheses and rejoins comma-terminated information lists split across lines.

parse_node_type extracts Node Type/Relation Name/Alias/Index Name/Scan Direction/Join Type/Partial Mode/Strategy/Parallel Aware/Async Capable; "Nested Loop" keeps its bare type, "Merge Left Join" becomes "Merge Join", and a missing join type defaults to "Inner".
A `Hash (cost=... rows=...) (never executed)` node is produced with Actual Loops, Actual Rows, Actual Total Time and Actual Startup Time all equal to 0.
The Vitest specs under src/services/__tests__ and src/__tests__, the from-text plan/expect fixtures, and the Playwright snapshots under tests/e2e are byte-identical after migration.

observations.surface: Property key strings in the serialized plan content
observations.atomic_claim: A parsed analyzed plan exposes keys "Actual Loops", "Actual Rows", "Total Cost" and "Plan Rows" with the same spellings as the TypeScript Property enum.
A node line with `rows=0.25` yields the marker `*Actual Rows Is Fractional` true and Actual Rows 0.25.
from_source("Seq Scan on t  (cost=0.00..1.00 rows=1 width=4)") returns plan content whose Plan.Node Type is "Seq Scan", while from_source("not a plan") returns an error.
split_balanced("a,(b,c),d", ",") returns ["a", "(b,c)", "d"] so commas inside parentheses are not treated as separators.
Every public capability and contract named in the goal remains available after migration; none is removed or redefined.
For analyzed plans create_plan subtracts child totals to get exclusive duration/cost and stores loop- and worker-adjusted times in the *...Revised fields.
parse_node_type("Index Scan using idx on t") yields Node Type "Index Scan", Index Name "idx", Relation Name "t" and Scan Direction "Forward".
get_plan_content({"foo": 1}) returns the error string "Invalid plan".
create_plan sets maxEstimateFactor to twice the maximum planner estimate factor, and to 1 when the plan has no estimate factors.
from_text("not a plan") returns the error string "Unable to parse plan".
Serializing the parse result yields nested Plan/Plans node objects plus Workers, JIT, Planning, Serialization, Triggers and Query Text with the same key strings as TypeScript.
create_plan sets isAnalyze true when the root has Actual Rows and isVerbose true when any descendant (including inside a CTE/InitPlan) has Output.

observations.surface: createPlan nodeId assignment and ctes collection
observations.atomic_claim: create_plan assigns sequential nodeId values and moves CTE/InitPlan nodes into the plan ctes list, removing them from their parent's Plans.
from_text("Seq Scan on t  (cost=0.00..1.00 rows=1 width=4)") returns content with a root Plan node of type "Seq Scan".
cleanup_source removes `|`/`║`/`│` frames, border/separator lines, wrapping quotes, `+`/`↵` continuations, the QUERY PLAN header and a trailing `(N rows)` line.
The solution performs genuine parsing and metric computation on the supplied inputs rather than hardcoding expected outputs for known fixtures.

observations.surface: pev2-core parsing, cleanup, line-splitting, node-construction and metric API
observations.atomic_claim: Given PostgreSQL EXPLAIN text or JSON, the Rust core returns parsed plan content and the derived metrics (maxRows, maxCost, maxTotalCost, maxDuration, maxBlocks, maxIo, maxEstimateFactor) that PlanService produced.
from_source parses a pure JSON document directly, routes a JSON-like framed payload to from_json, and routes plain EXPLAIN text to from_text.
A JSON ModifyTable node with Operation "Insert" is emitted with Node Type "Insert", and text `Insert on foo` yields Node Type "Insert".
In from_text, a `->  Seq Scan` line indented under `Nested Loop` becomes a member of that node's Plans array based on indentation depth.
create_plan computes maxBlocks.Shared/Temp/Local from the highest summed exclusive buffer counts and maxIo from the highest summed exclusive I/O read plus write time.
Preserve observable behavior for exports:./dist/pev2.css
from_json on a double-quoted JSON array payload returns the embedded plan content with the expected Plan node.
from_json slices only the lines between the opening `[`/`{` and closing bracket lines and replaces `""` with `"` before parsing.
create_plan computes content.maxRows, maxCost, maxTotalCost and maxDuration as the maxima of the corresponding node fields.
Under a `Nested Loop`, the first child gets Parent Relationship "Outer" and later children "Inner"; under an Append/Subquery Scan the applicable Member/Subquery values are set.
